mapper.select: select (select count(1) from wms_warehouse where status='0') warehouseCount, (select count(1) from wms_item where status='0') itemCount, (select coalesce(sum(s.quantity),0) from wms_stock s join wms_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id=s.warehouse_id and w.status='0' join wms_location l on l.location_id=s.location_id and l.status='0' join wms_area a on a.area_id=l.area_id and a.status='0' join wms_item i on i.item_id=s.item_id and i.status='0') totalStock, (select coalesce(sum(s.quantity-s.locked_quantity),0) from wms_stock s join wms_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id=s.warehouse_id and w.status='0' join wms_location l on l.location_id=s.location_id and l.status='0' join wms_area a on a.area_id=l.area_id and a.status='0' join wms_item i on i.item_id=s.item_id and i.status='0') availableStockQty, (select count(1) from ( select w.warehouse_id,i.item_id from wms_stock s join wms_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id=s.warehouse_id and w.status='0' join wms_location l on l.location_id=s.location_id and l.status='0' and l.location_type!='DEFECTIVE' join wms_area a on a.area_id=l.area_id and a.status='0' and a.area_type in ('STORAGE','PICKING') join wms_item i on i.item_id=s.item_id and i.status='0' and coalesce(i.min_stock,0)>0 group by w.warehouse_id,i.item_id,i.min_stock having coalesce(sum(s.quantity-s.locked_quantity),0)<=i.min_stock ) low) lowStockCount, (select coalesce(sum(total_qty),0) from wms_receipt where status='COMPLETED' and receipt_date>=curdate() and receipt_date<curdate()+interval 1 day) todayInbound, (select coalesce(sum(total_qty),0) from wms_shipment where status='COMPLETED' and shipment_date>=curdate() and shipment_date<curdate()+interval 1 day) todayOutbound, (select count(1) from wms_receipt where status='DRAFT') pendingReceipt, (select count(1) from wms_shipment where status='DRAFT') pendingShipment

select m.movement_id,m.biz_type,m.biz_no,m.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_code,w.warehouse_name,m.location_id,l.location_code,l.location_name, m.item_id,i.item_code,i.item_name,i.specification,i.unit,m.batch_no,m.change_qty,m.balance_qty,m.operator,m.operation_time,m.remark from wms_stock_movement m left join wms_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id=m.warehouse_id left join wms_location l on l.location_id=m.location_id left join wms_item i on i.item_id=m.item_id order by m.operation_time desc,m.movement_id desc limit 10

select date_format(t.business_date,'%Y-%m-%d') businessDate, coalesce(sum(t.inbound_qty),0) inboundQty,coalesce(sum(t.outbound_qty),0) outboundQty from ( select date(r.receipt_date) business_date,sum(r.total_qty) inbound_qty,cast(0 as decimal(18,4)) outbound_qty from wms_receipt r where r.status='COMPLETED' and r.receipt_date>=curdate()-interval 6 day and r.receipt_date<curdate()+interval 1 day group by date(r.receipt_date) union all select date(s.shipment_date) business_date,cast(0 as decimal(18,4)) inbound_qty,sum(s.total_qty) outbound_qty from wms_shipment s where s.status='COMPLETED' and s.shipment_date>=curdate()-interval 6 day and s.shipment_date<curdate()+interval 1 day group by date(s.shipment_date) ) t group by t.business_date order by t.business_date

select w.warehouse_id warehouseId,w.warehouse_code warehouseCode,w.warehouse_name warehouseName, coalesce(sum(case when i.item_id is not null then s.quantity else 0 end),0) stockQty from wms_warehouse w left join wms_area a on a.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id and a.status='0' left join wms_location l on l.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id and l.area_id=a.area_id and l.status='0' left join wms_stock s on s.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id and s.location_id=l.location_id left join wms_item i on i.item_id=s.item_id and i.status='0' where w.status='0' group by w.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_code,w.warehouse_name order by stockQty desc,w.warehouse_code
